meta.title: Stories of care from across India
meta.description: True, sourced stories of how people across India look after animals, from kolam doorsteps to stork baby showers. Every fact links to its source.

checks.title: How we check facts

points.sources: Every fact comes from a source we opened and read: a government record, the organisation itself, a book or a newspaper of record.
points.quotes: We quote people only in their exact words, from the place they said or wrote them. If we can’t find the original, we leave the quote out.
points.numbers: Every number has a date, because numbers change.
points.noLink: Friends of Animals has no connection with the people or groups in these stories unless we say so.
